$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the Prompt Cache settings: the acpmux daemon's timer that compacts an idle Claude chat while its prompt cache is still warm (cmux-tui/crates/acpmux/src/hub/cache_compact.rs), and how it batches and compacts wakes to a chat whose cache has lapsed (cold_wake.rs). The daemon reads these keys from the settings file each time it arms the timer and checks this file's defaults and ranges in its tests; gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and parser constants. Row fields: see schemas/settings/source/updates.json.

lists.name: agentCache
lists.note: Settings > General > Prompt Cache (Leo, 2026-11-03: "idk if we maybe also wanna be showing that/opt-in autocompact around that 5min mark"; "we ought to make these all accessibly toggle-able ofc"). agents.cacheCompact.* is off by default: a compaction is a model call that counts toward usage. agents.coldWake.* is on by default (Leo, 2026-11-24: "this can be toggled but... this as a default seems decent"): a cold wake rereads the whole uncached context, so batching and compacting first spend less.

rows.name: cacheCompactEnabled
rows.note: On: an idle Claude chat whose context is over agents.cacheCompact.minContextPercent runs /compact about 30 s before its prompt cache expires (once per idle stretch; never mid-turn, with a prompt queued, or while someone types). Off (the default): acpmux arms no timer.

help.text: Compacts an idle Claude chat while its cache is warm, so the next message costs less.

rows.name: cacheCompactMinContext
rows.note: The share of the context window (percent) a chat must be using before the timer compacts it.

help.text: Chats using less of their context window than this are left as they are.

rows.name: coldWakeEnabled
rows.note: On (the default; Leo, 2026-11-24: "this can be toggled but... this as a default seems decent"): once an idle chat's prompt cache has lapsed, acpmux holds its wakes (inbox notices, background-task notices, other agents' messages) and delivers them as one turn after a window of 60 s to 5 min that grows with the chat's context and how long it has been cold (cmux-tui/crates/acpmux/src/hub/cold_wake.rs). A block, a question and the person's own prompt never wait. Off: every wake goes in at once.

title.text: Batch Wakes After the Cache Expires

help.text: Gathers messages to an idle chat whose cache has expired into one turn, a minute to five later.

rows.name: coldWakeCompact
rows.note: On (the default): before a cold batch goes in, acpmux runs /compact on a Claude Code chat with at least 100K tokens of context, so the batch and every later turn read the summary instead of the whole cold context. Needs agents.coldWake.enabled on.

title.text: Compact Before Delivering to a Cold Chat

help.text: Compacts a large Claude chat before its batched messages go in. Needs batching on.
